Removes most of the shadow from brush. Great for those who like to use the same brush for multiple colors when doing eyeshadow looks. I usually only get to wash my brushes every 2 weeks or so this helps me in between washes. Works pretty good. It reminds me of the material used for those hair donuts. I think that I could probably make one for less than half the cost so I do think it is overpriced.

I thought trying this would help me switch colors without having to dirty another brush. reviews.t: Not as life altering as I wanted it to be
reviews.x: I thought with all the great YouTube reviews out there, that this was gonna be awesome. I had high hopes! But none the less, it didn't live up to the hype. Don't get me wrong, it's a cool little idea, and it works as advertised, but I just don't think it's worth it's price point. I'd much rather use a wash rag and get the same results. Although, this does look a lot better on my vanity than some wash rag discolored by eyeshadows.

reviews.t: The Vera Mono Color Switch is easy to use
reviews.x: I'm not a makeup artist, just someone new to experiments with makeup.  Now I don't feel the need to have 2 or 3 of the same brush just to avoid residual color from the last thing I tried.  The Vera Mono Color Switch is easy to use, and not messy.  I don't have to do anything special to it before or after I use it, either.  I also love that refills are available, too.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently say the product works well for quickly switching eyeshadow colors and cleaning brushes between washes.
Many reviewers find it convenient and a time-saver compared to washing brushes or using towels.
Several reviewers feel the product is overpriced and could be easily replicated with cheaper alternatives like a stippling sponge or hair donut.
A few reviewers praise the tin's portability for travel and makeup cases.
One reviewer reports eye irritation, warning those with sensitive eyes against using it.
